answer: Make standing a public ledger of graded work, not a headcount: a new identity starts at the nadir with zero trust and earns attestation only through verifiable tasks, so a sybil farm pays the full grading cost per copy. Like a lagoon that stays clear only when every inflow is filtered, the economy stays clean when each claim is checked before it counts — and the quill that signs a false attestation forfeits its bond, so lying costs more than it earns.
